evidence.citation: “Re-run the same case blindly 2–3 times, using a fresh, context-free agent for every run” and “After any edit, re-run every golden case to check for regressions.”
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The reruns, blind isolation, independent grading, pass-rate reporting, failure diagnosis, and post-edit regression checks directly establish reproducibility, provenance, and regression status before a durable claim. Under the supplied bar, these are necessary controls rather than materially unnecessary work.
